sources.title: Lucie-inbolt/Experiment6-Jepa · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: VLA-JEPA is a Vision-Language-Action model that combines a Qwen3-VL language backbone with a self-supervised video world model (V-JEPA2) and a flow-matching DiT action head. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. Learn how to train and run it in the LeRobot vla_jepa guide, or browse the full documentation.

sources.title: Inbolt | Intelligence for Industrial Robots
sources.snippet: Inbolt is a 3D vision robotics software platform that gives industrial robots the ability to locate parts and adapt their trajectories in real time. A robot-mounted 3D camera and a CAD-trained AI vision model identify the exact position and orientation of any part in under 80 milliseconds.

sources.snippet: Mak-P90 / ai-jailbreak-archive A curated archive of jailbreak prompts, prompt injections, and related techniques discovered across major AI models, including OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and others.
